features.label: Three replacement options
features.text: Choose the complete strap kit, CPS strap kit, or Velcro twist-fit attachment kit based on your needs.

features.label: Tool-free installation
features.text: Alligator tabs fold straps into place and color-coded buckles snap into keyholes for quick setup.

features.label: Promotes joint stabilization
features.text: Maintains consistent offloading pressure for recovery from meniscus tears and cartilage repair.

features.label: Hygienic replacement
features.text: Allows you to swap out dirty or worn straps for improved comfort during extended wear.

features.label: Universal compatibility
features.text: Fits the Rebound Cartilage OTS brace with a 12.2 to 24 in. calf circumference.

features.label: Latex warning
features.text: This device contains natural rubber latex which may cause allergic reactions.

measurement: These replacement kits fit the Rebound Cartilage OTS brace regardless of size, providing a universal fit for a 12.2 to 24 in. (31 to 61.5 cm) calf circumference. No new measurement is required for a replacement kit. Choose the Strap Kit Complete, CPS Strap Kit, or Velcro Twist-Fit Attachment Kit based on what needs replacing.
